per_case_results.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(T3."Enrollment (K-12)" - T3."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
WITH school_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s."school",
        s."doc",
        s."doctype",
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_diff
    FROM "schools" s
    JOIN "frpm" f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
    WHERE s."fundingtype" = 'Local'
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG("enrollment_diff") AS avg_enrollment_diff
    FROM school_diff
)
SELECT 
    sd."school",
    sd."doc",
    sd."doctype"
FROM school_diff sd
CROSS JOIN avg_diff ad
WHERE sd."enrollment_diff" > ad."avg_enrollment_diff"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT School FROM (SELECT T2.School, T1.AvgScrRead, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T2.County ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F') AS ranked_schools WHERE rnk <= 5
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "School Name"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        "frpm"."School Name",
        "frpm"."County Name",
        "satscores"."avgscrread",
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "frpm"."County Name" ORDER BY "satscores"."avgscrread" DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM "frpm"
    JOIN "schools" ON "frpm"."cdscode" = "schools"."cdscode"
    JOIN "satscores" ON "schools"."cdscode" = "satscores"."cds"
    WHERE "schools"."virtual" IS NOT NULL AND "schools"."virtual" != ''
) AS ranked_schools
WHERE county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY "County Name", county_rank
LIMIT 500
